title: OHDSI GIS toolchain: documentation, GIS vocabulary tools, and synthetic benchmark and tutorial datasets
description:
Documentation, GIS vocabulary tooling, and generators, scripts and inputs for the synthetic tutorial dataset (10,000 adults, 2,672 US counties) and the tract-level benchmark dataset (40,000 adults, four US states, 2014–2019) of the OHDSI GIS toolchain, which integrates geospatial data with the OMOP Common Data Model through a geometry-attribute index and two OMOP extension tables (LOCATION_HISTORY and EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE).

This release is the code and input snapshot behind the manuscript An OMOP-Compatible Exposure Infrastructure for GeoAI-Ready Environmental Health Research: The OHDSI GIS Toolchain. The database (GaiaDB), R package (GaiaCore), metadata catalog (GaiaCatalog) and deployment (GaiaDocker) are developed in separate repositories and are referenced here by commit. All persons, addresses and outcomes are synthetic; the exposure and boundary sources are public. The synthetic data do not demonstrate privacy preservation. Geocoding error distributions (distances only) are derived from a CC BY 4.0 source. The tutorial data include a minimal extract of the OMOP Standardized Vocabularies (SNOMED CT, RxNorm, LOINC and UCUM concepts) that retains the terms of its sources; see syntheticDataGIS/data/VOCABULARY_NOTICE.md. See the release notes for contents, reproducibility information and known limitations.
